# restate_cloud_byoc_region (Resource)

A Managed BYOC region: a Restate region in your own cloud account, which Restate builds and operates through a `READY` region grant. Once it is `ACTIVE`, create environments in it with `restate_cloud_environment` and `region` set to its `id`.

The region is built in the grant's cloud and cloud account, which the provider reads from the grant. Creation polls until the region is `ACTIVE`, and a region that fails to build stays in the state so it can be destroyed. Destruction polls until Restate has removed what it built, and Restate refuses while the region still has environments.

The API has no update operation, so changing any argument other than `deletion_protection` replaces the region.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A BYOC region in the grant's AWS account. Referencing the confirmation, not the grant, makes the
# region wait until the grant is READY, and makes a destroy delete the region before the grant.
resource "restate_cloud_byoc_region" "production_eu" {
  name         = "production-eu"
  grant_id     = restate_cloud_region_grant_confirmation.aws.grant_id
  cloud_region = "eu-central-1"

  # The default. Deleting a region removes everything Restate built in your account for it, so a
  # destroy, or a change that replaces the region, needs this set to false and applied first.
  deletion_protection = true

  # Building the network, cluster and storage takes a while. The provider polls until the region is
  # ACTIVE.
  timeouts {
    create = "90m"
    delete = "60m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_region` (String) The AWS region, GCP region or Azure location the region runs in, for example `eu-central-1`.
- `grant_id` (String) The `READY` region grant to build the region with, of the account or of its organization. A region keeps its grant for its whole life. Reference `restate_cloud_region_grant_confirmation.<name>.grant_id` rather than the grant itself, so the region waits for the confirmation and is destroyed before it.
- `name` (String) Name of the region, unique within the account: 3 to 40 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) When true, the default, Terraform refuses to delete this region, including for a replacement. Deleting a region removes everything Restate built in your cloud account for it, and the environments in it. Set it to false and apply before a destroy.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown for the region. Defaults to `name`.
- `machine_type` (String) Node type of the cluster's baseline node pool on GCP, or of its system nodes on Azure. Restate chooses one when it is omitted. AWS takes none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account the region belongs to.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud the region runs in, which is the grant's.
- `cloud_account_id` (String) AWS account, GCP project or Azure subscription the region runs in, which is the grant's.
- `created_at` (String) When the region was created.
- `id` (String) Region ID assigned by Restate Cloud, for example `rgn_a1b2c3d4e5`.
- `status` (String) `PENDING` while the region is being built, then `ACTIVE`. `FAILED`, `DELETING` and `DELETED` otherwise. A successful apply leaves it `ACTIVE`.
- `status_reason` (String) Why the region has its status, for example `CREATING_INFRASTRUCTURE` or `NEEDS_RESTATE_ATTENTION`. Empty when Restate reports none. More values may be added.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# BYOC regions are imported by account ID and region ID together.
terraform import restate_cloud_byoc_region.production_eu acc_1a2b3c/rgn_a1b2c3d4e5
```
